terms.gloss: spread on (the toothpaste, or butter on bread)

phrases.english: I want to spread it myself!
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

phrases.english: Spread the filling evenly over the base.

phrases.latin: Tracta singula in tōtum solum prīmum pōnitō, deinde dē mortāriō tracta linitō, tracta additō singulātim, item linitō
phrases.english: First lay single sheets of pastry over the whole base, then spread the sheets with the mixture from the mortar, add more sheets one at a time, and spread them in the same way

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
